stories.title: Consent Schema and Pydantic Contracts
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic models for consent tiers, consent state transitions, and storage decisions (store, de-identify, reject). Ensure strict validation of inputs flowing into consent_service and compatibility with tool_router.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Router Integration
stories.description: Expose consent workflow via FastAPI endpoints and integrate with tool_router to allow LLM-driven consent capture, tier escalation prompts, and enforcement decisions during conversations. Ensure allowlist compliance (GOV-004).

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Implement unit tests for consent tier logic, transition rules, and de-identification enforcement, plus integration tests covering interactions with lead_service, debug_logger, and unknown_question_service to ensure HIPAA-safe behavior across flows.
